Represents a view to invoke an action
Represents an image view in the item
Switch between a 13-key keyboard and a grid of customizable pads.
Toggle Polyphony. ON allows playing multiple notes. OFF limits to one note (Monophonic).
Record your session directly to an MP3 file on your device.
Toggle test playback state (Visual only in mock mode).
Select the base oscillator waveform: Sine, Square, Saw, or Triangle.
Shift the keyboard range down by one octave.
Shift the keyboard range up by one octave.
Adjust the overall output volume of the synthesizer.
Project Browser: Manage your music projects (Save, Load, Create).
Zen Mode hides the complex parameter controls to focus on the performance area.
Toggle the Sample Browser to load factory or recorded sounds onto pads.
Sample: %s. Click to enter mapping mode, then touch a pad to assign.
Pad Grid: Decrease the number of columns (vertical dividers).
Pad Grid: Increase the number of columns (vertical dividers).
Pad Grid: Decrease the number of rows (horizontal dividers).
Pad Grid: Increase the number of rows (horizontal dividers).
Switch to the previous bank of pads.
Switch to the next bank of pads.
Start or stop the 16-step MIDI sequencer.
Enable Real-time Recording. If the sequencer is playing, your keyboard performance will be recorded into the loop.
Enable Pad Sampling. While active, touching a pad will record the current engine output into that pad.
Step Recording: Each key you press will be recorded to the next sequencer step. Use REST to skip a step and BACK to undo.
Skip the current step without adding a note (Rest).
Go back to the previous step and clear it.
Clear all notes from the sequencer.
Toggle the Metronome. Heard as a click synced to the BPM.
Save the current synthesizer parameters (OSC, ADSR, LFO, Filter) as a named preset.
Load a previously saved synthesizer preset.
Sequencer Options: Access SAVE, LOAD, EXP, and Quantize settings.
LFO Rate: Speed of the oscillation (0.1Hz to 20Hz). Scale also affects LFO Depth.
LFO Depth: Intensity of the modulation effect.
Cutoff: Frequency above which sounds are attenuated. Resonance adds a boost at the cutoff point.
Resonance: Emphasizes frequencies near the cutoff point for a "squeaky" or "wet" sound.
Discovery Mode Active. Click any control for info.
